description: (K)₂NaPrBr₆ is High-temperature superconductor-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight K clusters inside a NaPrBr₆ framework. In each K cluster, K is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the NaPrBr₆ framework, Na is bonded to six equivalent Br atoms to form NaBr₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent PrBr₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-Br bond lengths are 2.89 Å. Pr is bonded to six equivalent Br atoms to form PrBr₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaBr₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Pr-Br bond lengths are 2.89 Å. Br is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one Pr atom.
